lines.zh: 铁链叮当响，悔恨囚徒缓行。
lines.en: Iron chains clink as the prisoner walks.

lines.zh: 狱中阴暗处，囚徒无声行。
lines.en: In the dim prison, the prisoner moves silently.
Heavy chains bind, each step weighed down.

lines.zh: 囚徒拖着脚步，步履蹒跚。
lines.en: The prisoner shuffles, each step a burden.
Chains scrape as the prisoner moves.
In the cold dungeon, the prisoner walks slowly.
Chains clink, the prisoner mutters.
Heavy chains, the prisoner moves forward.
The prisoner shuffles, each step hard.
Bound by iron chains, the prisoner advances

lines.zh: 赤脚踩过骨荒原的碎石。
lines.en: Bare feet crunch over the bone wastes.
It drags a wounded leg, one step at a time.

lines.zh: 囚徒目光呆滞，似已绝望。
lines.en: The prisoner's gaze is dull, as if in despair.

lines.zh: 囚徒懒散躺地，眼无生气。
lines.en: The prisoner lies listlessly, eyes lacking life.
In the dark corner, the prisoner sits idle.
The prisoner sits quietly, as if giving up.
Bound by chains, the prisoner sits idly.
The prisoner sits, his eyes hollow.
Hopeless in the dungeon, the prisoner sits idle.
Bound by chains, the prisoner sits lazily.

lines.zh: 囚徒眼神空洞，懒散坐地。
lines.en: The prisoner sits lazily, eyes hollow.
In the dark dungeon, the prisoner sits idly.

lines.zh: 囚服挂在瘦骨上，风一吹就响。
lines.en: The prison rags flap on its ribs.
It counts the scratches on the stone.

lines.zh: 它把头抵在冰冷的铁栏上。
lines.en: It rests its head on the cold bars.

lines.zh: 眼泪落在锁链上，无声无息。
lines.en: A tear falls on the chain without a sound.
The prisoner's gaze locks onto you.
Sharp eyes, the prisoner fixes on you.
Fierce eyes, the prisoner stares at you.
Evil eyes, the prisoner stares intently at you.

lines.zh: 铁链束缚，目光紧盯着你。
lines.en: Bound by chains, the prisoner's eyes fix on you.

lines.zh: 囚徒眼神空洞，却盯着你。
lines.en: Hollow eyes, but they focus on you.
The prisoner's eyes fix on you, dangerous.
Sharp eyes, the prisoner stares directly at you.

lines.zh: 铁锁链束缚，囚徒盯着你。
lines.en: Bound by chains, the prisoner stares at you.
Fierce eyes, the prisoner stares at you.
You're alive. You can still walk out.
Your clothes have no number.

lines.zh: 你袖子上有野地的草籽。
lines.en: Your sleeve has wild grass seed on it.
It stares at your bare ankles.
It looks past you, at the door.

lines.zh: 它在数你还剩多少自由。
lines.en: It counts how much freedom you have left.

lines.zh: 囚徒认出你也是被关住的。
lines.en: It sees that you are caged too.
That look belongs to no living thing.

lines.zh: 它向你伸出手，又缩回去。
lines.en: It reaches out, then pulls back.

lines.zh: 它把你的影子当成了钥匙。
lines.en: It mistakes your shadow for a key.
My bone wings are broken.
My body is weak.
My bones are cracked.
My muscles are torn.

lines.zh: 旧伤又裂开，黑水渗出来。
lines.en: An old wound splits; black fluid seeps.
My prison服is torn.

lines.zh: 这一刀下去，我笑了一声。
lines.en: The blade lands; I laugh once.
Chains wore through my wrists.
I lean on the wall to stay upright.
My bones crack.

lines.zh: 你身上有我们从未尝过的美味。
lines.en: You have something we’ve never tasted.

lines.zh: 监狱的铁栏不会永远束缚我。
lines.en: The prison bars won't hold me forever.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛透露了自由的气息。
lines.en: Your eyes give away the scent of freedom.

lines.zh: 你不知道我有多渴望自由。
lines.en: You have no idea how much I desire freedom.
Your flesh is exceptionally delicious.
Prisoners have rights too.
Escape is the only way out.

lines.zh: 我愿意用自由换取你的肉。
lines.en: I’ll trade freedom for your flesh.
I’ve never craved this so much.

lines.zh: 自由的气息让我无法抗拒。
lines.en: The scent of freedom is irresistible to me.
These hands of mine have been locked too long.
The door's open, and I still won't leave.
These shackles slow me.
Step aside; there is light beyond the wall.
The chain is still on my ankle.

lines.zh: 别想从我这里夺走食物。
lines.en: Don’t try to take my food away.
Do not touch the iron on my wrist.

lines.zh: 铁栏后等了太久，别挡我。
lines.en: I waited too long behind bars; move.
You’ve crossed my threshold.
I have held this cell too long.
Please, come to me.
My mate, come to me.
Let’s escape together.
I need you, my kind.
Let’s find freedom together.
Follow me, I’ll lead you out.
My love, respond to me.
The cell is locked; we cannot dance.
Let’s fly together.
My mate, don’t leave me.

lines.zh: 铁链在你手中发出沉重的声响。
lines.en: The heavy chains clank in your hand.

lines.zh: 你的手握住了冰冷的金属。
lines.en: Your hand grasps the cold metal.

lines.zh: 一滩血迹在你脚下蔓延。
lines.en: A pool of blood spreads beneath your feet.

lines.zh: 牢里的手，也能捡起你的东西。
lines.en: Even jailed hands can pick up your things.
The prisoner's shackles clink.

lines.zh: 你发现了它破碎的锁链。
lines.en: You find its broken chains.

lines.zh: 它的目光透过铁窗望向你。
lines.en: Its eyes look at you through the iron bars.

lines.zh: 锁链在它手中变得扭曲。
lines.en: The chains twist in its hand.

lines.zh: 它的皮带因饥饿而松弛。
lines.en: Its belt loosens from hunger.

lines.zh: 腐烂的肉块挂在它脖子上。
lines.en: Foul meat hangs from its neck.
Watch out, prisoner.
Its gaze is fixed on you.

lines.zh: 铁栏后面，我盯了你很久。
lines.en: Behind these bars I've watched you a long while.

lines.zh: 囚徒的视线从阴影中投射。
lines.en: The prisoner's gaze projects from the shadows.
It knows where you hide.

lines.zh: 囚徒的呼吸在黑暗中回响。
lines.en: The prisoner's breath echoes in the darkness.
Its footsteps grow closer.
It slowly emerges from the shadows.

lines.zh: 它的声音在夜幕下低语。
lines.en: Its voice whispers in the night.

lines.zh: 囚徒的眼神中满是杀气。
lines.en: The prisoner's eyes are full of malice.
You left the door unlocked.

lines.zh: 你身上带着钥匙的味道。
lines.en: You smell of keys.

lines.zh: 终于有人来陪我说话了。
lines.en: At last, someone to talk to.
You'll stay here in my place.

lines.zh: 我等的不是救兵，是替身。
lines.en: I wasn't waiting for rescue. I wanted a stand-in.
You came in. You don't leave.
Target, shoot, don't let him get close.
Focus, target the prisoner.
It moves within your sight.
You need to be ready.

lines.zh: 囚徒的身形越来越模糊。
lines.en: The prisoner's figure grows indistinct.

lines.zh: 保持警惕，注意它的动向。
lines.en: Stay alert, watch its movements.
It is slowly approaching you.
Concentrate, don't lose focus.
It is your sole target.

lines.zh: 不要让它靠近你的据点。
lines.en: Don't let it get close to your base.
Your shackles are lighter than mine.
Take your time. I can wait.

lines.zh: 我在数你走过来的步数。
lines.en: I count the steps you take toward me.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我的牢门口。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on my cell door.
No rush. The chain won't loosen.
The corridor behind you is empty.
At the corridor's end, you run.
You'll get used to these walls.

lines.zh: 我早就记得你的脚步声。
lines.en: I already know your footsteps.

lines.zh: 锁链的长度，刚好够到你。
lines.en: My chain is exactly long enough to reach you.
Growl, bite!
Scream, lunge at you!
Clench teeth, ready to attack!
Open bloody mouth!
Sssss, advance!
Scratch you with claws!
Rip you with roars!
Sss, close in to tear!
Howl and lunge!
Grab your throat!

lines.zh: 这口牙是狱里练出来的。
lines.en: These teeth were trained in a cell.
I've got your collar!
The chain is a weapon too.
Let me taste meat from outside.
That one was owed for ten years.
I bite you the way I bit the bars.
Call from the depths!
Head pops out of darkness!
Crawl from ruins!
Sssss behind iron gates!
Suddenly from a cell!
Break out, sss!
Flash from iron bars!
Shadow appears in darkness!
Unlock and escape!
Walk out of forgotten cells!

lines.zh: 锁链一响，我就站起来了。
lines.en: The chain rattled, so I stood.
This cell was empty too long.
The smell of rust woke me.

lines.zh: 我还记得自己怎么被关进来。
lines.en: I remember how I was locked in.
My number is still carved in the wall.
Don't put out that torch.
In the dark I can smell blood again.

lines.zh: 有人终于打开了我的门。
lines.en: Someone finally opened my door.

lines.zh: 铁栏断了很多年，我还在。
lines.en: The bars broke years ago; I remain.
The chain broke, and I woke.
Firelight finds the scars on my face.

lines.zh: 牢门是铁的，我的镣铐也是。
lines.en: Iron door, iron shackles.
Water enters my lungs.
Explosion wounds my body.
Arrow pierces my flesh.
Sorcerer's curse.
Starvation withers my body.
In the lightning, my shadow stays still.

lines.zh: 虚空之风撕裂了我的身体。
lines.en: Void wind tears me apart.
